title: SID ticks once per phi2 cycle
body: Sid6581.ClockDivisor is 1 so the SystemClock ticks the SID every master cycle; the 24-bit accumulator advances by Frequency per tick and the ADSR rate tables are resid phi2-cycle values. ConfigureAudioClock divides by ClockDivisor so the 44.1 kHz sample rate self-corrects.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Direct-Tick SID tests are divisor-independent; only SystemClock-driven calibration changed
